proposed_comments.title: Freeze diagnostics after the session stops
proposed_comments.body:
### Freeze diagnostics after the session stops

**Severity:** `medium`

`Stop()` captures the report end time, but retained request, load, and UI-probe objects can still mutate counters afterward. Add an atomic stopped-state check to `IconLoadDiagnosticsSession` entry points and to `IconRequestMeasurement`/`IconLoadMeasurement` update and completion paths. Late work should be ignored, and a worker waiting for an enqueue state must still be released rather than left blocked.

confidence.rationale: The measurement objects retain the session and currently have mutation paths that do not check its stopped state.

review.body_prefix: Thanks for adding the CmdPal icon diagnostics. I found three correctness issues that should be addressed before this ships: provider failures are reported as empty results, same-key refresh races can apply stale icons, and stopped sessions remain mutable through outstanding measurements.

judgment.rationale: Three valid correctness findings were fixed and validated on the fork. The final audit found no newer Copilot findings and zero unresolved Copilot threads; the supported findings remain applicable to the upstream head.
evidence: Provider exceptions are indistinguishable from empty icon results on the upstream head.
The stale-result guard checks SourceKey identity but not the request version, allowing same-key refresh races.
Stopped diagnostics sessions remain mutable through retained request, load, and UI-probe objects.
Focused CmdPal builds and 23/23 Microsoft.CmdPal.UI unit tests passed on the converged fork.
The fork Copilot thread audit reports zero unresolved threads.
judgment.recommended_action: After explicit approval and a current-head freshness check, post the three drafted comments as a request-changes review.
